result:
I’d make everyone share the consequences of the power they hold.

If a decision can hurt people, the person making it would have to carry a meaningful share of that risk—not necessarily the same harm, but the same stake. Leaders who send others into war would have to face the war. Those who profit from controlling essential resources would depend on them like everyone else.

It wouldn’t make everyone kind. But it would make indifference harder to practice, and power harder to use as if other people’s lives were disposable.
